subject: Safety-net action cards: pipeline tilt & commit updates
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20 09:14 PST
Subject: Safety-net action cards: pipeline tilt & commit updates

Team —

Quick heads-up from finance: we’re tracking a ~12% pipe-to-quota tilt on the mid-market seg going into close. Finance sent an extract (attached) and asked for a fast hygiene pass so we can present an updated run-rate to execs on Friday. Please do the following by EOD Wed (48 hours):

1) Update stage to the precise forecast stage (1-Discovery, 2-Qualified, 3-Commit, 4-Contracting) — do not leave ambiguous stage names.
2) Flag any deals you intend to commit in Q4 with the Deal property: "quarter_commit = true".
3) Tag all deals you want considered for the "safety-card" (these are small, high-certainty upsides that finance can count toward coverage) — use the tag exactly.
4) Add one-line reason for stage change in the Deal notes field (customer blocker, PO pending, legal review, pricing approved, etc.).

I attached a sheet with a starter filter (Q4, mid-market, ACV >= $40k). I’ll collate and push a cleaned view to the ops deck. If a deal needs a short recon call with finance, flag it in column H and I’ll schedule.

Attachments: Q4-pipeline-safety-net.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — this is a narrow window to improve coverage without inflating risk.

Marcus
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20 10:02 PST
Subject: Re: Safety-net action cards: pipeline tilt & commit updates

Thanks Marcus — copying my plan so it’s visible:

- I’ll sweep my book today (accounts: BrightWave, NeonGrid, Lumenix). I already have notes on BrightWave: they verbally approved scope last week but procurement asked for a 10% concession and a procurement questionnaire answer set. I’ll flag them as safety-card only if procurement confirms timing this week.
- Laura — can you confirm you can surface the legal review status for any deals in Contracting? If legal is the blocker we should not mark as safety-card.
- Ben — please prioritize stage cleanup on deals > $50k in your list. Short note in the deal history is fine.

If anyone sees a deal that’s truly non-starter, mark it CXL in the spreadsheet and set expected_close_date to null — don’t move it to a different quarter.

I’ll update BrightWave status after a quick prod to procurement (cc’ed below) and paste reply into the thread.

— Sofia
Sr. AE, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

Nice work team — appreciate the quick sweep and the clear notes. A couple of follow-ups: 

- Sofia: please mark BrightWave as safety-card=false until Emma confirms PO timing. Finance will only count it if procurement confirms budget flows this week.
- Ben: solid notes. Please add estimated probability and expected_close_date in the spreadsheet for every deal you flagged — finance wants a numeric aggregation.
- Laura: if legal can provide a binary "legal clear / legal holds" for Contracting deals by 3pm PT today that will let us finalize the coverage view.

I will consolidate and push an updated slide to the ops deck by 5pm PT. If we still show >10% coverage shortfall I’ll schedule a 20-min triage with sales leads and finance Thursday morning.

Thanks —
